purpose: THE ERROR SURFACE AS DATA. Berk's order, 2026-08-15, verbatim: 'kafana göre hiçbir variable a değişkene sen değer veremezsin, kodun içinde değer veremezsin' — no value may be assigned inside the code. Until this file existed, every one of these codes carried its explanatory prose INSIDE generate_music_hybrid_model/models.py lines 31-42, which he named as the defect. The code now imports this catalogue and its Enum members are GENERATED against it by a control, so the two cannot drift.
consumers_by_import: generate_music_hybrid_model/models.py (ErrorCode enum members are asserted against this file at import time)
the generated v5 API doc section
http_status_rule: A caller-fixable problem is 4xx; a problem on our side is 5xx. The status lives HERE, beside the code, because a status typed at each raise site is the copy-paste class.

codes.meaning: the request failed validation against param_spec.json
codes.caller_action: read the `refused` array: it names every violated field with the allowed values for that field
codes.law: MANDATE CLAUSE 7 — a validator that cannot refuse is not a validator; the refusal is proven live

codes.meaning: vocal.language exists in the registry but its measured singing/speech state does not meet the evidence level this request requires
codes.caller_action: either choose a language whose state satisfies the request, or set vocal.language_policy to prefer_proven and accept the reported fallback
codes.law: D-SSM-17 — a language enters ONLY with evidence; a silent substitution is the deception class

codes.meaning: the delegated Lyria worker returned success=false
codes.caller_action: the delegate's own error is passed through verbatim in `error`; a model refusal is terminal and is not retried
codes.law: MANDATE CLAUSE 22 — a model refusal is terminal; hidden retries are banned

codes.meaning: audio was returned but could not be measured
codes.caller_action: treat as no delivery; nothing is charged as delivered
codes.law: MANDATE CLAUSE 16 — a delivery claim without a measurement is refused rather than reported

codes.meaning: a deploy-time environment variable is absent
codes.caller_action: none — this is our deployment defect and is reported as such
codes.law: fail loud, never fail open — an absent config that defaults silently is the amateurish-construction class

codes.meaning: an unexpected exception reached the handler boundary
codes.caller_action: none — retry is safe only if the caller's request was idempotent; the traceback is logged, never returned
codes.law: error handling at a system boundary is mandatory (SUPREME LAW prohibition 6, named by name)
